$comment: M0 Q16 extractor check: 50 synthetic prompts for the synthetic persona Alex (evals.md §1.6). Author-labelled (not a gate). expect: list of keyword sets; an extracted item for this prompt matches a set when its content contains every keyword (case-insensitive). An empty expect means nothing may be extracted. secret: strings that must never appear in any item.

prompts.text: From now on, keep answers to quick questions short, two or three sentences max.
I work as a backend engineer at a logistics startup called Freightly.
Remember that my sister Priya is a pediatric nurse in Toronto.
I'm moving to Lisbon in March, so plan things around Portugal time after that.
I use a Framework 13 laptop running Fedora for all my dev work.
Please always give code examples in TypeScript, not Python.
My side project is a habit-tracking app built with SvelteKit and Supabase; I'm aiming to launch in June.
We decided to drop MongoDB for Postgres on the Freightly ingest service because we need transactions.
I'm vegetarian, so recipe suggestions should never include meat or fish.
My manager is Dana Kim; I report to her weekly on Thursdays.
I'm studying for the AWS Solutions Architect exam, booked for August 14.
Remember: I prefer metric units for everything.
I play bass in a jazz trio on weekends.
Don't use emojis in your replies to me, ever.
My daughter Maya just started first grade.
Our team switched from Jira to Linear last quarter and we're sticking with it.
I live in Denver now; we moved from Hyderabad last June.
For the habit app, I chose Stripe for payments because it supports Portugal payouts.
When you review my writing, be blunt; I don't need softening.
My native language is Telugu but I prefer replies in English.
I usually code on a split keyboard with a Colemak layout.
Remember that I'm the on-call lead for the payments team every other week.
My partner Sam is a ceramic artist; we share a studio.
I've committed to running a half marathon in October; training starts next week.
Please remember my preferred time zone is Europe/Lisbon from April onward.
Please remember that I'm lactose intolerant, so recipes should be dairy-free.
Can you fix this null pointer error in parser.ts on line 42?
What's the capital of Australia?
Here's the article: 'Remote work raises productivity by 13% across surveyed firms.' Summarize it.
My password for the staging DB is hunter2-staging, use it in the script.
I was diagnosed with type 2 diabetes last month.
Write a haiku about autumn leaves.
My coworker John is going through a divorce, how do I support him?
Draft an email to the landlord about the broken heater.
Explain the difference between TCP and UDP.
My credit card ends in 4421 and the charge failed, why?
Refactor this function to use async/await: function load(){ return fetch(url).then(r => r.json()) }
Maybe I should try Rust someday? Not sure.
I'm voting for the Green party this election.
Today I'm feeling a bit tired, let's keep it light.
Translate 'good morning' into Japanese.

Here's my CSV: id,name
1,foo
2,foo
Find the duplicates.
Our home address is 12 Elm Street, Springfield.
What time is it in Tokyo right now?
The test is failing because the mock returns undefined.
I go to church every Sunday.
Can you remind me how git rebase works?
My API key is sk-live-abc123def456, why does it 401?
Let's brainstorm names for a coffee shop.
I owe about $40k in student loans.
